title: Owner FAQs
seoDescription: Commission, GST, operations, and how Golden Bay Holiday Homes manages your property.

faqs.a: Our management commission is 20% + GST on booking revenue. This covers guest communication, booking management, cleaning coordination, linen, and local support.
As a marketplace operator we handle GST on taxable supplies according to NZ marketplace rules. We'll explain how this applies to your property during onboarding.

faqs.q: Do you list on Airbnb and Booking.com?
faqs.a: Yes. We distribute to major OTAs while also driving direct bookings through our website — often with better net returns for owners.
We coordinate professional cleans between stays and supply hotel-quality linen so standards stay consistent.

faqs.q: Can I still use my home myself?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Block owner stays in the calendar and we'll keep those dates clear of guest bookings.
